scope: Phase 5 stimulus-aligned (S1 event-trigger sync) multi-substrate measurement; tests F-CT-ALIGNED-1/2 (silver: |r_s|>=0.20, p_perm<0.05, CI_lo>=0.10).
honest_c3_caveats: C1: ZuCo subjects (ZAB) read static sentences; Algonauts subject (sub-01) watched Friends. CLM-EEG pair uses POSITIONAL sentence pairing (Friends sentence pool randomly sampled per ZuCo trial), NOT content-shared. Only CLM-BOLD is truly stimulus-aligned (Friends transcript text matched to BOLD HRF-lagged TR).
C2: HRF lag +4 to +6s is canonical assumption (no per-subject HRF estimation); +/-20-30% r attenuation possible vs ideal.
C3: N_BOLD~300 pairs target. EEG side uses sliding-window aggregation (32-fix trials, step 16) yielding ~50-100 trials/session; total ~400-800. Power=0.93 at silver if true r>=0.20.
C4: Spearman primary chosen for substrate-scale invariance (CLM ~30, EEG ~varies, BOLD ~21 from Phase 4). z-Pearson reported as triangulation.
C5: Single subject per substrate (ZAB / sub-01); population-generic claim NOT supported.
C6: Phase 5 PASS does NOT replace Phase 4 FULL ($500-2000 H100 LoRA) — measures phi-formula portability, not BLM head training.

C7 (NEW v2): ZuCo SR sentence text not present in available preprocessed data dump; spec mode-A sentence-content alignment degraded to fixation-event-trigger alignment + positional CLM pairing. True CLM-EEG content-shared pairing requires raw ZuCo task1-SR sentence list (not in /tmp/zuco_sample/).

C8 (NEW v2): BOLD per-sentence window EXTENDED to >=24 TRs (~36s) to satisfy phi formula sample minimum (N>=2*HID_TRUNC=16). This degrades temporal stimulus-alignment precision: per-segment phi reflects ~36s of context, not just the dialog moment. Per-pair Spearman thus measures formula portability over a ~36s post-dialog window, not strictly per-utterance.
